title: Art exhibition at KU Medical Center highlights healthy aging, partnership with Spencer Museum
summary_en: An art exhibition opening at the University of Kansas Medical Center this week uses visual, sound and interactive elements to explore age-friendly healthcare. The show is the result of a partnership with the Spencer Museum of Art to embed Kansas artists within the Kansas 4M Interprofessional Age Friendly Scholars program.
title_cn: Art exhibition at KU Medical Center highlights healthy aging, partnership with Spencer Museum

title: New documentary chronicles link between racial trauma, mental health experienced by Asian American communities
summary_en: In a new documentary, a professor of sociology at the University of Kansas weaves together personal testimony, historical analysis and creative artistic expression to illuminate the layered realities of racial trauma in AAPI (Asian American Pacific Islander) communities.
title_cn: New documentary chronicles link between racial trauma, mental health experienced by Asian American communities

title: The Commons announces Red Hot Research dates for fall 2026
summary_en: The Commons will host Red Hot Research events for University of Kansas faculty on Oct. 30, Nov. 6 and Dec. 4. One Red Hot Graduate Research event will take place Nov. 13.
title_cn: The Commons announces Red Hot Research dates for fall 2026
